description: Use this when the user asks in chat to change what is on the open Shoot Board. add puts items on it; set replaces the whole item list (to remove items, send the ones to keep); clear empties one type, or without type starts a new shoot on the same board (its brief is unlinked; photos stay in the library); add_as_view makes from_garment_id's photo the back, side or detail view of garment_id and takes from_garment_id off the board, only after the user agrees the two show one garment. Items are {type, id} from search_uwear_library or read_shoot_board. To reuse an automation, add {type: automations, id: a workflow_id from brief_inputs.automations}: the board pins one and the next brief runs every look through it. Pass expected_revision from read_shoot_board; on revision_conflict, apply the change to the returned board once.

action.description: add: put items on the board; set: replace all items; clear: remove one type, or without type everything and the board's brief (a new shoot on this board); add_as_view: from_garment_id's photo becomes a view of garment_id

board_id.description: The open Shoot Board's board_id, from Open Shoot Board or your context.

expected_revision.description: Board revision this write is based on; a stale revision returns a revision_conflict error with the current board instead of overwriting it

from_garment_id.description: add_as_view: the board garment whose photo it is; it leaves the board

garment_id.description: add_as_view: the board garment that gains the photo as a view

items.description: add / set: the items. An automations item (id: a workflow_id from brief_inputs.automations) pins the Automation every look of the brief runs through; a board pins one, a new one replaces it. A board holds one art direction the same way

type.description: clear: only this type; omit for a new shoot (the whole board and its brief)

view.description: add_as_view: back, side, or detail (a close-up)

name: modify_shoot_board
title: Change Shoot Board
